files.esoi.toml:
package = "pkg"
package_dir = "pkg"
code_paths = ["pkg"]
python_path = ["."]
structure_dir = "esoi"
evaluation_dir = "evaluation/components"
files.esoi/components.csv:
component_id,layer,path,role,solutions
alpha,core,pkg/alpha.py,Alpha.,sol-alpha
eval-alpha,evaluation,evaluation/components/alpha_eval/**,Alpha cases.,sol-alpha
beta,core,pkg/beta.py;pkg/beta_prompt.txt,Beta.,sol-beta
eval-beta,evaluation,evaluation/components/beta_eval/**,Beta cases.,sol-beta
gamma,core,pkg/gamma.py,Gamma.,sol-gamma
eval-gamma,evaluation,evaluation/components/gamma_eval/**,Gamma cases.,sol-gamma
delta,core,pkg/delta*.py,Delta.,sol-delta
eval-delta,evaluation,evaluation/components/delta_eval/**,Delta cases.,sol-delta
util,core,pkg/util.py,Shared utility.,sol-util
eval-shared,evaluation,evaluation/components/*.py,Shared fixtures.,
files.esoi/metrics.csv:
metric_id,name,command,solution_ids
m-alpha,alpha,esoi run alpha_eval --impl live,sol-alpha
m-beta,beta,esoi run beta_eval --impl live,sol-beta
m-gamma,gamma,esoi run gamma_eval --impl live,sol-gamma
m-delta,delta,esoi run delta_eval --impl live,sol-delta
files.esoi/implementations.csv:
implementation_id,solution_id,filepath
sol-alpha:live,sol-alpha,pkg/alpha.py
sol-beta:live,sol-beta,pkg/beta.py
sol-gamma:live,sol-gamma,pkg/gamma.py
sol-delta:live,sol-delta,pkg/delta.py
sol-util:live,sol-util,pkg/util.py
